statement: A committed runnable example under examples/request-binding-deployment demonstrates the landed deployment surface end to end against a live locally booted node: it installs a genuine WASI component Artifact through INSTALL SERVICE (component source and reproducible build step committed, no opaque-only binary), declares one immutable request Binding through CREATE BINDING pinning package_id, manifest_digest, and export, authorizes its declared table through CONFIGURE SERVICE ACCESS, and an HTTP request matching the Binding method and static path returns the genuine component's status, headers, and body from a ready Cell; the live example run observes declared-table effects, denial of undeclared table access, and zero component invocations for unmatched routes.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
